### Request to Replace a Phytosanitary Certificate

The trader asks for this certificate to be replaced. If you accept, the trader amends the NPQS application and adds a note; you then issue the replacement certificate and send it to the IPPC ePhyto Hub as a replacement for this one. If you reject it, the certificate stands and the trader is told your remarks.
